title: LLM Synapse Gateway
description: Gateway traffic, latency, fail-open and replica (vLLM/mockllm) load. Provisioned from deploy/compose/grafana/dashboards; edit the file, not the UI.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Requests per second on the OpenAI-wire routes, all statuses.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status or that failed after the status was sent (aborted, stream_error). Client disconnects (client_closed, 499) are not counted as errors.

panels.title: TTFT p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time to first byte through the gateway.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests currently sent to a replica, all gateways.

panels.title: Fail-open rate
panels.description: Optimization stages skipped per second (request forwarded unchanged).

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Scrape targets (gateway, mockllm, vllm) that are down. Names from the other profile never appear.

panels.title: Request rate by pool and status
panels.description: gateway_requests_total by final HTTP status, or by outcome when the response failed after its status was sent: aborted (handler panic), stream_error (upstream failed mid-response), client_closed (caller disconnected mid-response). Pool "none" is requests rejected before a pool was resolved.

panels.title: TTFT p50 / p95 by class
panels.description: Time from request arrival to the first response byte relayed to the caller (gateway_ttft_seconds).

panels.title: In flight per replica
panels.description: Requests currently sent to each replica, summed across gateway instances (gateway_inflight).

panels.title: Request duration p50 / p95 by class
panels.description: Time from request arrival until the response is complete (gateway_request_duration_seconds).

panels.title: Upstream errors by replica and kind
panels.description: Upstream failures before or during the response. kind: connect, timeout, canceled (caller went away), other.

panels.title: Fail-open by stage and reason
panels.description: Optimization stages skipped, request forwarded unchanged (gateway_failopen_total). Should be zero in steady state.

panels.title: Client disconnects
panels.description: Requests whose caller went away before the response was complete, per gateway instance. The upstream request is cancelled so the replica frees KV cache.

panels.title: Conversation stickiness
panels.description: Ratio of affinity-matched routing decisions to total decisions. Target >= 0.98.

panels.title: Routing policy decisions
panels.description: gateway_route_decisions_total rate by policy (affinity, round_robin) and outcome (affinity, overflow, over_cap, failopen, no_healthy_ring, retry, round_robin, no_healthy_replicas, no_replicas). over_cap: concurrent routes filled every ring candidate past cap + slack, so the least-loaded replica was taken.

panels.title: Routing decision latency (overhead)
panels.description: Routing overhead duration in seconds. Target <= 100 µs p99.

panels.title: Replica load distribution (in-flight)
panels.description: Requests in flight per replica, summed across gateway instances and classes (gateway_inflight). Bounded load ensures no replica exceeds (1 + ε) × avg.

panels.title: Replica ejections by reason
panels.description: Replicas taken out of their pool's affinity ring (gateway_replica_ejections_total): transport_failure (passive), health_check_failed (active /health), stuck_engine. Requests still route to the remaining replicas, so ejections are not fail-opens (those are in the fail-open panel above).

panels.title: Queue depth by pool and class
Prefix-cache hit rate
panels.description: vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total / vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total (tokens), per replica.

panels.title: Running / waiting requests
panels.description: vllm:num_requests_running and vllm:num_requests_waiting per replica. Waiting > 0 means the replica is queueing.

panels.title: KV-cache usage
panels.description: vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc (0-1) per replica; falls back to the pre-V1 vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc.

panels.title: Replica TTFT p95
panels.description: vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds p95 per replica. Compare with gateway TTFT to see the gateway's added latency.

panels.title: Token throughput
panels.description: Prompt and generation tokens per second per replica.
